items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: So I did work with him. That's who I was working with when I got the call to go in the post office. I was working with Fess.

ctx.x: Then after the war was over, Harry Truman was President. That was cool, because the other guys came back. Well, then, that was the height of what you'd call the Depression or whatever it was, there weren't any big bands, the shows were closing, the big shows, the Capitol, the Strand, Broadway. Of course, the Paramount, that was still going.
And up in Harlem, everyplace was closing (inaudible), everyplace was closing. So there wasn't much work to be done. But there was a fellow that was getting jobs. You ever hear of Fess Finley?
